svg.title: STM32 FreeRTOS sensor node architecture
svg.desc: A NUCLEO-L476RG reads a BME280 over I2C1 or a simulated sensor. Three CMSIS-RTOS2 tasks form a fixed-priority pipeline. acq_task samples on a DWT-timestamped 1000 ms period and publishes to a 16-entry sample queue. process_task keeps 32-sample ring buffers per channel and measures end-to-end latency before publishing to an 8-entry stat queue. console_task prints every tenth stat over USART2 and checks the acquisition heartbeat. A full queue drops the newest sample and logs it. FreeRTOS tickless idle and an optional STOP2 path provide low power.
svg.text: fixed-period acquisition → queue-decoupled statistics → console + watchdog
g_acq_heartbeat → console: ERROR if unchanged for 3 × period
stat_msg_t → sample + t_proc_us + e2e_latency_us + 3× ring_stats + seq
osMessageQueuePut(..., 0) · osMessageQueueGet(..., wait) · ringbuf_push / ringbuf_stats · micros()
timestamps travel in the message, not in globals
DWT CYCCNT · unsigned deltas wrap-safe (≈71 min @ 80 MHz)
console prints every 10th stat · timing illustrative, not to scale

g.text: all tasks blocked → SysTick off · optional STOP2 + RTC wake
ringbuf + stats · no HAL/RTOS deps · gcc + assert in CI

svg.text: example output · values illustrative; on-target latency and sleep current are still to be measured
